experiment_data.hypothesis: Hierarchical/partial-pooling confusion estimation reduces downstream subgroup CATE RMSE relative to global pooled and independent per-subgroup estimation across DGP regimes with heterogeneous subgroup misclassification; the advantage should be strongest under high misclassification severity and positive CATE-error correlation, and may shrink under low severity or weak heterogeneity.

spec.command: bash -c "set -euo pipefail; cd /root/ec_hte; mkdir -p docs/results logs; /root/miniconda3/bin/python experiments/e008_stage1_dgp_robustness.py --n 5000 --reps 100 --budgets 500 2000 --seed 20260531 --out docs/results/e008_stage1_dgp_robustness.json 2>&1 | tee logs/e008_stage1_dgp_robustness.log"
spec.data_path: synthetic DGP grid generated by experiments/e008_stage1_dgp_robustness.py via e002 Stage 1 functions
spec.checkpoint_source: e002_budgeted_confusion_estimation success result and D009 Stage 1 robustness decision; no model checkpoint used
spec.eval_data: synthetic DGP grid: subgroup_count=[4,6,8], misclassification_severity=[low,medium,high], cate_error_correlation=[positive,zero,negative], n=5000, reps=100, budgets=[500,2000]

hyperparams.low_heterogeneity_note: Not included because minimum 27-cell grid already covers required regimes with nonzero CATE heterogeneity and keeps runtime small on the single allocated GPU.

metrics: mean/max subgroup bias by grid cell/B/method
confusion recovery RMSE by grid cell/B/method
partial win count and rate across cell-budget tests
failure slices where partial is not best
spec.notes: D009 Stage 1 robustness. Local dry-run and remote dry-run passed before submission. Remote initial dry-run with n=800 failed only because B=2000 exceeded n; rerun with n=2500 passed. Formal run uses requested reps=100.
